question: Which months stand out in how quickly we closed support tickets? Take tickets opened in 2024 and 2025 that have a resolved date, compute the mean days to close for each opening month, and flag months whose mean is more than 2 standard deviations from the average of those 24 monthly means. Give each flagged month (YYYY-MM) and its mean days to close.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH monthly_means AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', created_date) AS opening_month, AVG(JULIANDAY(resolved_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)) AS mean_days FROM support_tickets WHERE created_date >= '2024-01-01' AND created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND NOT resolved_date IS NULL GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', created_date)), stats AS (SELECT AVG(mean_days) AS grand_mean, SQRT(SUM((mean_days - (SELECT AVG(mean_days) FROM monthly_means)) * (mean_days - (SELECT AVG(mean_days) FROM monthly_means))) / COUNT(*)) AS stdev_days /* SQLite doesn't have STDEV built-in standard function; we compute population or sample standard deviation */ FROM monthly_means) SELECT m.opening_month, m.mean_days FROM monthly_means AS m CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE ABS(m.mean_days - s.grand_mean) > 2 * s.stdev_days ORDER BY m.opening_month LIMIT 500
